heading.title: Maintenance of Public Order and Tranquillity

article.title: Magistrate may prohibit repetition or Continuance of public nuisance
article.content: A District Magistrate or Sub-divisional Magistrate, or any other Executive Magistrate or Deputy Commissioner of Police empowered by the State Government or the District Magistrate in this behalf, may order any person not to repeat or continue a public nuisance, as defined in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, or any special or local law.
article.html:
162Magistrate may prohibit repetition or Continuance of public nuisance

Section 162 · Chapter XI · Public nuisances

A District Magistrate or Sub-divisional Magistrate, or any other Executive Magistrate or Deputy Commissioner of Police empowered by the State Government or the District Magistrate in this behalf, may order any person not to repeat or continue a public nuisance, as defined in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, or any special or local law.
